question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Nobody knew Ramesh was coming to see us. He arrived **__suddenly__**.
solution:
The correct answer is **"unexpectedly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

 

__
 
• The word "suddenly" means quickly and unexpectedly. (एकाएक, अचानक)

 
 
• Example: ***Suddenly**__, everybody started shouting.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is "unexpectedly."
 
• The word "unexpectedly" means in a way that was not expected or regarded as likely. (अप्रत्‍याशित रूप से)
 __
 
• Example: *One of her friends passed away **unexpectedly**__ this week.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Safely: **in a way that gives protection from danger or risk. (कुशलपूर्वक)
 
• **Angrily: **in a manner resulting from or betraying anger. (क्रोधपूर्वक, ग़ुस्‍से से, क्रोध से)
 
• **Happily: **in a happy way. (प्रसन्‍नतापूर्वक)
